Title: Pahadi Rajma (Premium Himalayan Kidney Beans)
Body (HTML):
Heirloom red kidney beans cultivated in the pristine high-altitude valleys of Uttarakhand. Naturally sun-dried, completely unpolished, and packed with mountain flavor.

Renowned for its tender melt-in-mouth texture and sweet, earthy undertones, our Pahadi Rajma is grown by smallholder mountain farmers without harmful pesticides or synthetic fertilizers. Unlike commercial polished beans, these unpolished Himalayan kidney beans retain their nutrient-rich red skins, cooking to a rich, silky gravy with a delicate aroma that pairs flawlessly with steaming basmati rice and a dollop of Pahadi A2 Ghee.

Key Highlights:

  • 100% Unpolished & Pure: Free from chemical polishing, mineral oils, or artificial color enhancements.
  • High-Altitude Heirloom Harvest: Grown in mineral-rich mountain soil fed by glacial spring water.
  • Tender & Quick-Cooking: Softens beautifully with natural buttery texture without needing cooking soda.
  • Nutrient-Dense Powerhouse: Abundant in clean plant-based protein, dietary fiber, iron, and potassium.

Culinary Tip: Soak for 6-8 hours and slow cook with ginger, garlic, hing, and Ghar Aangan spices for an unforgettable authentic Pahadi Rajma experience.

Title: Pahadi Bhatt Ki Dal (Traditional Black Soybean)
Body (HTML):
Uttarakhand's iconic indigenous black soybean, hand-harvested from Himalayan terrace farms. A nutrient-dense superfood central to Kumaoni and Garhwali culinary traditions.

Bhatt (Black Soybean) is celebrated as the cornerstone of authentic Pahadi nutrition. Rich in deep anthocyanin pigments and hearty iron, Bhatt is the star of legendary mountain recipes like Bhatt ki Churkani, Bhatt ka Jaula, and Bhatt ke Dubke. Sourced directly from local hill farming families, our unpolished black soybeans are sun-cured to lock in maximum bioactive nutrients and hearty mountain flavor.

Key Highlights:

  • Ancestral Himalayan Superfood: High in natural anthocyanins, antioxidants, and essential micronutrients.
  • Superior Plant Protein: Exceptionally high protein content, supporting sustained energy and muscle recovery.
  • Traditional Winter Wellness: Naturally warming pulse traditionally savored to boost immunity during cold weather.
  • 100% Raw & Unpolished: Absolutely free from chemical coatings, additives, or industrial refining.

Culinary Tip: Lightly roast the beans in iron Kadai with mustard oil or ghee before grinding or simmering for authentic smoky Churkani gravy.

Title: Pahadi Gahat Ki Dal (Himalayan Horse Gram / Kulthi)
Body (HTML):
Ancient Himalayan horse gram (Kulthi), traditionally stone-cleaned and sun-dried. Revered in Ayurveda and mountain homes for its wholesome warmth and therapeutic properties.

Cultivated on rugged Himalayan slopes where only resilient native heirloom crops flourish, Gahat (Kulthi) has been an integral part of the mountain diet for generations. It is famous across Uttarakhand for dishes like Gahat ke Dubke, Gahat ki Rasmi Badi, and stuffed winter parathas. Revered in Ayurvedic medicine for its warming potency (Ushna Virya), it has been traditionally used to maintain urinary wellness, promote healthy kidney function, and facilitate body warmth.

Key Highlights:

  • Ayurvedic Therapeutic Pulse: Widely celebrated in herbal folklore for supporting kidney and urinary tract health.
  • Slow-Burn Energy & Low GI: Packed with complex carbohydrates, dietary fiber, and lean protein for long-lasting satiety.
  • Unpolished & Chemical-Free: Retains all natural husks and minerals without chemical polish or preservatives.
  • Pure Mountain Sourced: Grown in chemical-free soil and pure mountain air by Uttarakhand farming clusters.

Culinary Tip: Soak overnight, slow cook with Pahadi spices, and blend partially for comforting, thick Gahat ke Dubke.

Title: Pahadi Lobia Dal (Mountain Black-Eyed Peas)
Body (HTML):
Delicate, creamy white mountain cowpeas (Lobia) grown in Himalayan terrace fields. Exceptionally light on digestion and loaded with lean plant protein and dietary folates.

Sourced from high-elevation village farms in Uttarakhand, our Pahadi Lobia is sun-cured and unpolished, preserving its creamy taste and tender outer skin. With its subtle nutty flavor and quick-cooking character, it yields a luxurious, comforting curry that is easy on the digestive system and packed with natural nutrition suitable for all ages.

Key Highlights:

  • Gentle on Digestion: Extremely light and soothing, making it a great daily source of wholesome nutrition.
  • Rich in Folate & Fiber: High in soluble dietary fiber, potassium, and essential B-vitamins for gut and heart health.
  • Quick-Cooking & Versatile: Cooks tenderly without lengthy boiling; wonderful in curries, dry sabzi, or fresh protein salads.
  • 100% Unpolished: Zero polishing agents, artificial colors, or preservatives.

Culinary Tip: Boil with a pinch of turmeric and salt, then toss with chopped cucumber, tomatoes, and Pahadi Bhaang Loon for an instant healthy mountain salad.
